description: Source code implementing functions for color primaries, transfer functions, and color space conversions based on ITU-T H.273 standards within the skia graphics library.

methods.name: CICPGetPrimaries
methods.description: Retrieves the color primaries based on an input code, mapping to predefined primaries or invalid.

methods.name: CICPGetTransferFn
methods.description: Retrieves the transfer function based on an input code, with options for sRGB preference.

methods.name: CICPGetSkColorSpace
methods.description: Constructs an SkColorSpace object based on primaries, transfer characteristics, matrix coefficients, and range flags.

methods.name: CICPGetSkYUVColorSpace
methods.description: Determines the YUV color space based on matrix coefficients, range, and bits per color.
